name: Florida State University
header:
Florida State University
United States · Mathematics PhD
Rank verification is maintained separately.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Choose pure mathematics area carefully; funding may not transfer if area changes.
• Complete application for funding December 15; final academic April 30 is much later.
• Faculty below form a verified research-fit shortlist, not a complete census. New-student supervision and 2027
leave/moves must be confirmed; paper dates describe the cited version.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Upper-division undergraduate GPA ≥3.0 required. Apply to a specific math major (pure best matches stated
interests); UChicago degree route eligible subject completed bachelor’s and review. [s1]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Select one area, optional second choice. Area change later/funding transfer not guaranteed. Submit initial app,
then Status Page material requirements appear within one day; add references/upload/pay there. [s1] [s3]
Adviser contact [Unresolved]
No public requirement to secure an adviser before submitting was established in the admissions pages
checked. Use the research-fit shortlist for potential contacts and confirm 2027 availability/graduate supervision
eligibility. A faculty listing does not promise an opening. [s1] [s3]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Initial submission followed by Status Page activation/materials within a day; pay fee, add referees, upload and
self-report tests there. [s3]
Cycle verification [Standing rule]
Central applications explicitly open Fall 2027; math December 15/April 30 dates year unspecified. [s1] [s3]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [Standing rule]
Standing April 30 academic deadline; fall only. International priority January 15 centrally, but math funding
December 15 earlier. Year/timezone not explicit on math page. [s1] [s4]
Funding consideration [Standing rule]
December 15 complete-file priority for TA/RA/tuition and Graduate School fellowships; April 30 applicants only
remaining funds. Earliest fellowship nomination deadlines first week January. [s1] [s2]
Reference receipt [Standing rule]
Three letters part of complete application; target December 15 funding priority. No separate grace established.
[s1]
Test-score receipt [Unresolved]
Official English required if not waived; most departments may begin review self reports on Status Page,
pending official. Math specific grace not established. [s4]

Supporting documents [Standing rule]
All materials and fee by applicable program deadline; apply by December 15 for funding. No published math
grace. [s1] [s3]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
No binding program-wide acceptance deadline for Fall 2027 was established in the public admissions pages
checked. Use the individual offer and ask the program if unclear; do not infer April 15 merely from an earlier
CGS signatory list. [s1] [s3]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
Central old TOEFL 80/new 4.0, IELTS 6.5, DET 125, PTE 55, Cambridge 180, Michigan 55; official scores, with
self reports for initial review in most departments. Math may prefer higher. [s1] [s4]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Earned U.S. BA or higher can waive university test; math also exempts English-country degree. In-progress
UChicago waiver timing unverified. TA SPEAK requirements separate. [s1] [s4]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Math says GRE scores not required; not the generic temporary master’s waiver. Voluntary handling unverified.
[s1]
GRE Mathematics [Unresolved]
GRE scores not required generically; separate math subject recommendation/voluntary handling not stated.
[s1]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Unresolved]
TA/RA include tuition waiver, stipend varies by teaching assignment and health insurance subsidy; no exact
current math rate on checked page. [s2]
Years of support [Unresolved]
This particular funding term was not established by the public program/admissions material checked. Obtain
the exact rule in the funding offer or from the graduate coordinator; neither eligibility nor a guaranteed
amount/duration is inferred from silence. [s1] [s3]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
International students may apply for department assistantships/fellowships; federal grants/loans unavailable.
TA English assessment separate. [s4]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
PhD-only TA positions; timely progress rules. Area-specific awards/funding may not transfer on change major.
[s1] [s2]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Select Yes to financial-assistance question in application. Some Graduate School fellowships department
nominated, others separately applied. [s1] [s2]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Tam Family adds $5000/year 5 years but only applied/computational or biomathematics, not pure math; B
minimum each course and timely progress. Other Graduate School awards award-specific. [s2]

Application fee [Standing rule]
$30 USD by credit/debit/e-check on Status Page after submission. [s3]

Graduate Admissions explicitly unable to waive graduate application fee. [s3] [s4]

sections.text:
Algebraic / arithmetic geometry
Paolo Aluffi
Intersection theory, characteristic classes of singular varieties, and stringy/Mather classes. [faculty1]
Distinguished Research Professor; availability unconfirmed.

cycles
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Jeremy Usatine
Motivic integration, Artin stacks, crepant resolutions, and stringy invariants. [faculty2] [faculty2a]
Assistant Professor; availability unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2026 · A motivic change of variables formula for Artin stacks
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Oishee Banerjee
Topology/cohomology of algebraic moduli spaces, stability, and arithmetic consequences. [faculty4]
Assistant Professor; UChicago PhD, 2019; availability unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2024 · Filtration of cohomology via symmetric semisimplicial spaces
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Number theory / arithmetic geometry
Amod Agashe
Modular forms and Hecke algebras, elliptic curves and modular abelian varieties, rational torsion and the
Birch-Swinnerton-Dyer conjecture. [faculty5] [faculty5a] [gapc47] [gapc48] [gapc49]
Current FSU university-hosted research page and September 2026 publisher articles confirm FSU affiliation; retain rank from
base dossier.
Research evidence: 2022; newer submitted titles listed without dates · Darmon points on elliptic curves over totally real fields
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Research evidence: 2026 · Reducibility and rational torsion in modular abelian varieties
Amod Agashe and Matthew Winters; Journal of the Ramanujan Mathematical Society 41(3), September 2026, 253-261.

Research evidence: 2026 · The index of a certain quotient of the Hecke algebra in its normalization
Amod Agashe; same journal issue, September 2026, 287-291. Congruences of eigenforms control normalization index primes.

 Earlier group: Number theory
Earlier interests: Elliptic curves, modular forms, rational torsion, and Birch-Swinnerton-Dyer phenomena.

confirmation.
